title: Inject BookmarkRepository (with its ContentIndex) into CompletionRepositoryImpl instead of ad-hoc-constructing it for delegated profiles
why: _advanceBookmark only uses the DI-injected BookmarkRepository (wired with a ContentIndex for O(1) adjacent-item lookups via bookmarkRepositoryProvider) when the target profile equals the active session profile. For any delegated-profile completion — BulkCompletionRequest.profileId is documented for exactly this: 'add track for a child while the session active profile differs' and bulk_prior_completion_service.dart exercises it from onboarding — the code instead `new`s a fresh BookmarkRepositoryImpl without passing contentIndex:, silently falling onto the documented O(N) full-curriculum scan fallback on every bookmark advance. completion_repository_impl.dart also directly imports another feature repository (bookmark_repository_impl.dart), the pattern SM-8 exists to prevent. completion_repository_impl_test.dart's setUp never injects a bookmarkRepository at all, so this branch (and the fast/slow-path difference) is exercised by every test in the file yet never asserted — a regression here would ship silently.
recommendation: Thread a `BookmarkRepository Function(int profileId)` factory (or the ContentIndex itself) into CompletionRepositoryImpl via its constructor/provider, matching how completionRepositoryProvider already injects CompletionDetectionService, instead of constructing BookmarkRepositoryImpl by hand inside _advanceBookmark.
acceptance_criteria: completion_repository_impl_test.dart gains a case with bookmarkProfileId != activeProfileId that asserts the ContentIndex fast path is used (e.g. mockContentRepository.getContentForCurriculum is not called when a ContentIndex is supplied).
